text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Paul Johnson started coverage of Xylan Corp, a maker of network switching equipment, with a long-term attractive rating.
-- Johnson estimates fiscal 1997 earnings at $0.68 a share, and $1.12 for fiscal 1998.

-- "There is a lot of opportunity for upside surprse in revenues and earnings as the market for advanced switching systems experiences rapid unit growth over the next few years," Johnson said in a statement.
-- Xylan should benefit from demand for network switching equipment with "one of the most advanced" product lines in the industry, he said.
-- The stock was up one at 21-1/2 at midday Wednesday.
